name: EC3 Bendigo (Edge Centres)
notes: Regional edge colocation facility in Bendigo (Innovation Ct, Kennington VIC 3550, listed as Bendigo Telco on Data Center Map; EC3 Bendigo on Baxtel). Directory-only evidence; capacity and current operator status unverified; small edge/colo footprint.

name: NEXTDC GE1 Geelong (Corio)
notes: NEXTDC GE1 in Corio industrial precinct (Greater Geelong LGA); ~4MW IT capacity and ~2,100 m2 technical space, targeting Tier IV; NEXTDC official page lists GE1 as in development; contractor Kapitol reports construction underway (LinkedIn); state government approval reportedly within 28 days.

name: NEXTDC Lovely Banks land acquisition (future campus)
notes: NEXTDC acquired ~169 ha of farmland at Lovely Banks, Geelong northern growth corridor (Greater Geelong LGA) for a reported A$165m; landbank for a future hyperscale campus; no planning application or facility scope verified - lead only (C).

name: CDC Brooklyn Campus One (BK1)
notes: CDC's first Melbourne campus in Brooklyn (Hobsons Bay LGA), operational since 2024; two live facilities with a third in planning as of Feb 2026 per techlearn; capacity not disclosed in sources checked; corroborated by CDC LinkedIn campus event reference.

name: CDC Laverton North campus
notes: CDC campus in Laverton North (Hobsons Bay LGA) listed in Data Centers.com directory and an AI/data-center policy atlas; stage and capacity not verified - needs CDC official page or planning confirmation before upgrade.

name: NEXTDC M2 Melbourne (Tullamarine)
notes: NEXTDC M2 at Tullamarine (City of Hume LGA), ~25,000 sqm technical space per Urban Developer report; operational Melbourne facility; part of NEXTDC Melbourne M1/M2/M3 portfolio.

name: AirTrunk MEL2 (Tullamarine)
notes: AirTrunk second Melbourne campus in Tullamarine (City of Hume LGA); w.media (2026) places MEL2 in Tullamarine and reports MEL2 at 354MW+ with Melbourne total 630MW+ (reported ultimate campus capacity, not phase-1 IT load); AirTrunk announced north-west Melbourne site acquisition for MEL2.

name: Zerra DC Campbellfield campus (300-340 Barry Road)
notes: Former Ford assembly plant site at 300-340 Barry Road, Campbellfield (City of Hume); proposal for six-building data centre campus within 60-ha ASSEMBLY redevelopment (Pelligra Group); ~AUD 1.1bn, planning application under assessment; DCD 8 May 2026, The Age 7 Aug 2026 report community controversy (diesel volumes).

name: Mickleham data centre campus (45 Donnybrook Road)
developer: AirTrunk (reported; applicant unnamed in planning documents)
notes: Hyperscale campus proposed at 45 Donnybrook Road, Mickleham (City of Hume): seven data centre parcels, application received by DTP 1 Jul 2026 under Victoria Development Facilitation Program; Real Estate Source reports AirTrunk acquired the 67-ha Fusion Business Park site for ~AUD 350m; ~AUD 4bn investment reported by Herald Sun; status = announced/planning pipeline.
